artworks.title: A Seated Soldier
artworks.medium: black chalk over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a man from mid-thigh upwards. He is leaning back on his left hand while holding a stick with a string or strap attached in his right hand. The man's head is turned to his right, and he has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He is wearing a military-style cap, a high-collared shirt, and a jacket with epaulets on the shoulders. There are buttons running down the front of the jacket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Death of Sapphira
artworks.artist: Follower of Jan de Bisschop, after Guercino
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash with black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in full-body view engaging in dynamic interaction. The central person is leaning forward with an arm outstretched towards another figure. This central figure has a prominent beard and hair, suggesting a mature male, and is wearing draped robes. The individual on the left is shown from the back, in a lively posture with arms raised, wearing a gown that flows with their movement and hair pulled back in a bun. The third figure stands to the right, partially visible with hands raised, appearing to be an older male with a bald head and draped garments. The background has sketchy architectural features and a cloudy sky. No jewelry or objects are depicted.

artworks.title: Saint Bernard of Clairvaux with the Instruments of the Passion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash and black chalk, incised for transfer on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the waist up. He is in a three-quarter view, looking down. The man has a receding hairline and is wearing a religious robe. In his hands, he holds a bundle of straw-like objects tied together, a large wooden cross, elongated objects, a large key, and a rosary. There is a faint halo around his head. In the background, there is a cloth with a face drawn on it, a column with a rooster on top, a ladder, and an open book in the foreground. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing contour and shading.

artworks.title: Five Studies of a French Pointer
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of dogs in various poses. The drawing features several sketches of dogs in dynamic positions on a blank background. The dogs are depicted in a realistic style, capturing the texture and musculature of their bodies. The primary dog in the center is standing with its head lifted, while others are in different poses, including standing, running, and laying down. Each sketch captures a sense of motion and attention to detail, suggesting an observational study of the canine form.

artworks.title: Interior of the Colosseum
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of an ancient circular structure, possibly an amphitheater. Two figures are seated on the ground, one appears to be drawing. More figures stand nearby, providing scale to the structure. The background features a bright sky with a few clouds, surrounded by the curved walls of the structure. The top of the walls forms the horizon line, depicting decay and sporadic greenery. The painting style is light and fluid, resembling watercolors. Warm earth tones are used for the ruins and lush greens for vegetation, while the sky is a soft blue.

artworks.title: The Arch of Titus and the Temple of Venus and Rome near the Roman Forum
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays ancient Roman architecture in a historical site. The viewpoint is elevated, showing a wide view of ruins and structures. The horizon is in the upper third, with distant buildings and a sky. The brushwork is detailed, showing the texture of the buildings. The color palette includes browns, yellows, greens, and pale blue. Close by are exposed ruins with arches, while further back are grand structures with columns and walls. Many small figures are visible throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Eritrean Sibyl
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a figure drawn in ink, depicting a person standing. The person is facing slightly to the side with a gaze directed upwards. The facial features are rendered in fine lines, giving the face a serene expression, framed by hair styled in a bun with a decorative element. The figure is dressed in flowing robes and holding a shield or tablet with inscriptions with both hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: red chalk on light tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three figures seated together. On the right, a woman is sitting with a baby on her lap. The woman has finely detailed features, pinned-up hair, and a flowing gown. The baby has curly hair and is reaching towards the woman. On the left, another seated figure is holding an open book. The figure appears older with a beard and flowing hair, hunched over the book. The sketch is done in red chalk on cream-colored paper, with faint outlines of trees in the background.

artworks.title: A Chinese Peasant
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The pencil sketch shows a person in a walking stance, with one leg in front of the other. The figure is leaning slightly forward with minimal facial features and short hair. Their attire appears loose and suggests movement. The person carries a long object over their shoulder and holds a circular item by their side. The background is sparse, with faint lines indicating ground or terrain, and a subtle outline of a column in the distance. The sketch focuses on capturing motion and form.

artworks.title: A London Character
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash and watercolor on thin card
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their arms crossed, slightly turned to the side. They have distinctive features, a focused expression, short hair partly covered by a white headscarf, and wear a dark cloak with fringed edges over a white garment. The person's feet are in black shoes. The background is plain and light, with the initials "I. C" seen at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Adored by Saint Catherine and Another Female Saint
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three female figures seated among clouds. The central figure, a woman, holds a child on her lap with serene features and long flowing hair. The child is nude and seated gently. To the left is another female figure with long hair and a halo, holding a scroll on her lap. The third female figure on the right is also seated, looking upward. The background consists of cloud formations.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Classical Dress
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched scene with two figures captured from the waist up. The figure on the left is seated, leaning slightly forward, with their head turned to face the standing figure. Their hair is styled in a neat bun, and they have strong, defined facial features. The standing figure has short hair and gently downward-cast eyes. Both figures are dressed in flowing garments. There appears to be no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a mix of dark and light shadings, creating depth and a sense of space, with abstract lines suggestive of a dimly lit room or an atmospheric setting.

artworks.title: Charioteers (recto and verso)
artworks.medium: pen and purple-black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving horses and figures. The image features fluid, energetic lines capturing a moment of action. Horses are depicted in motion, with some rearing up, and figures are shown interacting with the horses, likely riding or controlling them. The drawing style suggests movement and liveliness, with a sense of chaos and energy in the composition. The drawing conveys a sense of narrative and drama, freezing a moment from a larger story.

artworks.title: "The Woman That Was"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman and man standing side by side. The woman is on the left, looking down, holding an umbrella. The man is on the right, hands behind his back. The woman has aged features, short curled hair, and wears a dress. The man has a moustache and beard, wearing a striped suit and hat. A small dog is between them, and the background consists of lush foliage.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper attached to album page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene featuring a figure sitting against a tree. The image is detailed and textured, with a focus on the trees and foliage. The foreground includes vegetation around the figure. The figure holds a staff and wears a draped garment. In the background, there is a winding path leading into the distance. The drawing is done in shades of brown to create contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of trees in a sketch-like style. The trees are positioned slightly left of center on a subtle incline. There is limited color, focusing on warm tones and dark lines. The trees are outlined with fine pen lines without much shading. Branches with sparse foliage extend upwards in the foreground, while distant trees and bushes are lightly suggested for depth. The background is bare, enhancing the simplicity of the central trees.

artworks.title: Illustration for Longfellow's "The Rainy Day"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash and white and cream gouache over graphite, with parts of the distant mountains drawn with a stylus, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a high perspective, featuring distant, snow-capped mountains under softly clouded skies. The painting uses delicate, fluid brushstrokes to create a serene scene with a muted color palette dominated by earth tones. A rugged terrain with sparse vegetation and a branching tree is depicted in the foreground. A body of water separates the foreground from a dark landmass in the distance, contrasting with the bright mountain peaks.

artworks.title: A Young Benedictine Monk Kneeling
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a male figure kneeling on the ground. The person's body is turned at an angle, and his head is tilted slightly upward. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and closed or half-closed eyes, while his hair appears short. He is wearing a robe with loose sleeves. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background has a plain texture and shows a faint sketch of another figure in a similar pose behind the main figure.

artworks.title: A Design for a Saltcellar
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a central figure standing in a dynamic pose, with one arm raised holding a billowing fabric. There are four smaller figures surrounding her with aquatic features, interacting with swirling waves or clouds. The central figure has long hair and the background is blank. The drawing is rendered in fine lines with a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
artworks.medium: black chalk and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a kneeling figure dressed in a long robe with a hood and a rope belt. The person's head is turned slightly to the side as they gaze upward. The figure's facial features are delicately rendered with a calm expression and short hair. Multiple cherubic figures surround the central figure, with three on either side and one above. The cherubs have wings and are lightly sketched, suggesting movement and interaction. The central cherub is standing on a cloud or raised surface and has an outstretched hand pointing upward. Soft cloud shapes are sketched in the background above the figures.

artworks.title: Male and Female Bathers
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on beige card
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals swimming in the sea. The woman on the left has her eyes closed and wears a red cap with a yellow trim, while the man on the right has short dark hair and a beard. The water around them is painted in soft shades of blue and green, with a rocky coastline and pale sky in the background.

artworks.title: An Elaborately Sculpted Frame
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and red-brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curvilinear shapes creating an abstract composition. The flowing forms resemble intricate architectural details like ornate moldings or decorative plasterwork, suggestive of rococo style. The sketch also includes elements resembling a vase with foliage, adding organic form among the structured abstract lines. These features may evoke decorative elements found in classical interiors or grand palatial designs.

artworks.title: Two Kneeling Figures with Offerings
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash, heightened with white on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in different poses. One figure is an older male with a large nose and beard, reaching out with one arm. He wears a robe with a hood covering his head. The other figure is a younger female with flowers in her hair, holding a basket on her lap. The background is a textured surface with no distinct features.

artworks.title: A Tormentor With Tongs
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in a dynamic stance. The figure is in mid-motion with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm extended outward, holding a long staff or club across their chest. The facial features are exaggerated, with a large, curved nose, a pronounced chin, and focused eyes. The person's hair is styled under a head covering. The clothing is loosely draped, giving a sense of flowing movement, with sketchily drawn folds and contours. The figure is holding a staff-like object. The background is plain, with a light, textured paper, providing no additional scenery or context.
